correctness.rationale: Every order-two lift in PGL2(k[epsilon]/epsilon^2) comes from a 2-dimensional adjoint -1 eigenspace. The simultaneous A,B,AB eigenline calculation gives exactly q disjoint K_{q,q} between commuting distinct base fibers. Exact dihedral base centralizers give degree strata, q^6 commuting ordered pairs and q^4(q²−1)/6 unique triangles. Finite q=3,5 projective arithmetic checks corroborate all counts and edge uniqueness; odd prime-power proof is symbolic.
